title: Subtraction within 1,000
introduction: Build on Primary 1 knowledge and practise subtraction within 1,000.
definition: Subtraction finds a difference or the quantity remaining. Align place values. If a digit is too small to subtract, regroup from the next place; check by adding the difference back to the subtracted number.

examples.question: Calculate 600 − 247.
steps: Regroup one hundred into ten tens, then one ten into ten ones.

exercises.question: A shop has 725 notebooks and sells 289. How many remain?
